messages:
zoe.m: Aurora Systems procurement uploaded a SIG/CAIQ and asked for: EU-only residency for EU customers, BYOK with HSM-backed keys, and clarity on model fine-tuning data retention. Deadline: Friday morning. Can security triage?
sec_bot: Intake created INT-AURORA-2026-22 -> security-triage. SLA 72h. Priority: high.
rick: Thanks. Quick Q: will the POC involve fine-tuning with customer data or just prompt-based evals? That changes retention controls.
zoe.m: POC includes a short fine-tune on customer support transcripts (redacted) plus embeddings. They want proof we won't retain training artifacts beyond POC.
celine: Picking this up. Initial triage items: 1) BYOK HSM support (we support cloud HSM-backed CMKs; require key policy + cross-account role). 2) Fine-tune retention: need clear purge workflow and logs. 3) Evidence: SOC2 + pen test + model training purge attestations.
nikhil: For HSM-backed CMKs we require customer KMS ARN and an IAM role with kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt. We'll provide an example key policy and CloudTrail sampling instructions.
clara: Infra note: For POC we can spin a short-lived EU-dedicated environment and mount customer CMK for S3 SSE-KMS. Model artifacts from fine-tune will be stored on ephemeral FS and wiped post job; we can produce a purge log.
legal: If HSM keys are used we need to check contract for key-control language and whether key escrow is allowed. Also confirm whether customer wants attestation signed by a third party.
rick: I'll draft CAIQ top-12 answers focused on training data, key mgmt, and purge controls. Plan to post within 24h.
celine: Action items: 1) Provide HSM key policy template (owner: nikhil). 2) Document fine-tune purge workflow + sample logs (owner: clara). 3) Upload SOC2 redacted (owner: zoe.m). 4) One-page security summary for procurement (owner: celine).
sec_bot: INT-AURORA-2026-22 status: triage_in_progress -> in_progress at 1752001800 by celine
nikhil: Key policy snippet (short): arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:555555555555:key/aurora-hsm. Cross-account role must include kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt. Will upload full template.
clara: Purge workflow: fine-tune job writes model.tar -> upload to ephemeral S3 with lifecycle rule immediate delete after job; we will run a deterministic purge job and store a SHA log. I'll upload the purge audit sample.
zoe.m: SOC2 and pen test redaction uploaded to intake portal. Link: https://files.redwood/aurora/secdocs
rick: CAIQ top-12 answers posted. Flagged a technical gap: embeddings checkpoint caching may persist tokens temporarily; mitigation: turn off persistent cache for POC and document.
celine: Uploaded 1-pager security summary and the HSM key policy template. Noted HSM onboarding adds ~5 business days.
legal: Customer asked for a signed attestation that model artifacts were purged. We can provide an internal attestation signed by security; third-party attestation would need separate scope.
zoe.m: Aurora said they can accept internal attestation for the POC. They want final confirmation of the BYOK HSM flow and purge attestation by Friday AM.
sec_bot: INT-AURORA-2026-22 status: in_progress -> resolved_by_celine at 1752003600
celine: Closing notes: added HSM pattern to KB, included purge audit template and CAIQ answers. If Aurora requests production HSM integration, open a new intake with longer lead time.
